Method of Attack: ransomware attack reducing government activity, encrypting files and demanding bitcoin payment for decryption key
Impacted Systems: major US newspapers including Tribune Publishing, Los Angeles Times, Wall Street Journal, New York Times, Chicago Tribune, Baltimore Sun, Lake County News-Sun, Post-Tribune, Hartford Courant, Capital Gazette, Carroll County Times
Indicators of Compromise: cryptocurrency wallets monitored by MalwareHunterTeam receiving more than 400 bitcoins in about four months
